stories.new_fact: D.C. Circuit judges questioned the government about limits on presidential authority over the Washington Guard deployment.

stories.new_fact: Residents are commenting on the proposed roughly 220-mile Grid Growth high-voltage transmission project.
stories.new_takeaway: Siting input is most consequential while alternatives and conditions remain open.
stories.why_now: NBC4 published the active-comment-window reporting October 14.
stories.previous_coverage: No Grid Growth segment in the prior seven scripts.

stories.new_fact: Bank of America home-loan volume declined 12 percent sequentially to $9.8 billion; first liens were $6.8 billion and home equity $2.9 billion.
stories.new_takeaway: Loan shops need distinct first-lien and second-lien capacity views rather than one mortgage-volume lens.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior episodes covered delivery rules and home-equity technology, not Bank of America Q3 production mix.
stories.uncertainty: One bank's quarterly mix does not prove a marketwide borrower preference.
stories.watch: Next disclosures on equity balances, underwriting performance and delinquencies.

stories.new_fact: Starling announced a transactional foundation model with NVIDIA, trained and hosted on Civo's UK sovereign cloud.
stories.new_takeaway: Model hosting and data lineage are preconditions to a bank AI use case, not evidence of a customer outcome.
stories.previous_coverage: October 14 covered TD's production mortgage document work; this is a different bank, infrastructure task, status and conclusion.
stories.uncertainty: No named live use case, quality metric, cost baseline or customer result was disclosed.
stories.watch: Named transaction workflow and measured outcome.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Starling / transactional foundation model and sovereign-cloud hosting as announced lane 8 infrastructure; no live workflow metric disclosed.

stories.new_fact: xAI released Grok Voice 3.0, repointed grok-voice-latest to it, and deprecated version 2.0.
stories.new_takeaway: Alias-based voice deployments need version pinning and rerun evaluations because the production model can change underneath them.
stories.why_now: Release notes and announcement are dated October 14.
stories.previous_coverage: No Grok Voice or speech-to-speech deployment segment in the prior seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: Performance figures are provider-reported and lack regulated-workflow error, escalation and cost-after-review data.
stories.watch: Independent replicated call-task tests and user evidence after migration.
stories.frontier_bar: Concrete capability and deployment-interface change with disclosed benchmark claims.

stories.new_fact: Bank of America reported Q3 net income of $6.9 billion and higher average loans and leases year over year.
stories.new_takeaway: Bank-level growth and first-lien mortgage production can diverge.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent market segments focused on CPI and oil rather than this earnings result.
stories.uncertainty: Results are preliminary company data and not a sectorwide conclusion.
stories.watch: Peer bank releases and actual borrower pricing.

stories.new_fact: NWS forecast a high near 73, a 20 percent shower chance late morning to early afternoon, and possible evening storms with gusts to 23 mph.
stories.new_takeaway: Plan for a mostly dry commute but recheck before evening outdoor activity.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine daily forecast, not counted toward freshness.
